تستنطقوا (form X)
# تَسْتَنْطِقُوا (tastanṭiqū) /tas.tan.tˤi.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# تُسْتَنْطَقُوا (tustanṭaqū) /tus.tan.tˤa.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
